lead_profile_text: Existing property looking for higher return
stl_goal: Convert an underperforming 5-bed all-ensuite HMO (currently breaking even) to short-let for meaningfully higher return

profile_confidence: high — built and sold a lettings business in 2013, interrogated data source/methodology, pressed for a confidence level rather than accepting the figure
primary_blocker: Tenancy notice required for existing HMO tenants before short-let transition can begin
language_signals: What's the data source behind your analysis?
Just what's your confidence level that you will achieve the numbers?

zac_language.objection_handling_pattern: On the confidence-level question, answered candidly rather than overselling ('maybe not loads more than the HMO') and then pivoted to control/hassle/competition as the real differentiators

what_they_focused_on: data source and methodology behind the projection
achievability/confidence level, not just the headline figure
what_they_needed_most: a real forecast-vs-actual case study, not just a projection

profile_psychology_intersection.recommended_meeting_adjustment: With sophisticated, data-literate leads, do not oversell — candid answers on achievability convert better than enthusiasm; keep a forecast-vs-actual case study ready to deploy at the confidence-level moment
